title: One circuit rewriting step
statement: Given an emitter, a state consisting of a list of rewritten gates and a list of vertex indices, and a gate $g$, replace each argument index of $g$ by the corresponding entry of the index list, using $0$ when the index is out of range. Apply the emitter to this relabeled gate and the rewritten gate list, then keep the emitter's new gate list and append its output index to the index list.
hypotheses_covered: An emitter from a gate and gate list to a gate list and output vertex
A state consisting of a gate list and a natural-number list
Out-of-range argument indices are replaced by $0$
